tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Window chrome: sidebar, title bar, status bar. The deepest ground.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, buttons at rest, popovers.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover rows, inset wells, neutral badge ground, empty meter segments.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs, switches): 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface and on heat-0 to heat-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, axis ticks on surface-100, -200 and -300.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (timestamps, hints) on surface-100 and surface-200 only.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Brand phosphor. Primary button fill and the Time metric (timeline, sparklines). Text on it: on-data.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text or a thin line on surfaces and on amber-soft.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Amber badge and selection ground.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Input phosphor: the Keys metric. Text on it: on-data.

tokens.name: cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan as text or a thin line on surfaces and on cyan-soft.

tokens.name: cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Cyan badge ground.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: The Clicks metric. Text on it: on-data.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Rose as text or a thin line on surfaces and on rose-soft.

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Rose badge ground.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The Network metric (download and upload). Text on it: on-data.

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: Lime as text or a thin line on surfaces and on lime-soft.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Lime badge ground.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The Uptime metric and third-party sources (CSV). Text on it: on-data.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Sky as text or a thin line on surfaces and on sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Sky badge ground.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Idle and away segments on the timeline. Text on it: ink-muted.

tokens.name: on-data
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on any data fill (amber, cyan, rose, lime, sky) in both themes.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heat scale, empty: no activity. Calendar and keyboard heatmaps.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heat scale, low.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heat scale, medium. Labels in ink.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heat scale, high. Labels in on-heat.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heat scale, peak. Labels in on-heat.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Key labels on heat-3 and heat-4.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states as text or icon ("Imported", "Backup verified") on surfaces and success-soft. Always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failures as text, icon or destructive button fill. Always with a word or glyph, never hue alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge and error banner ground.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. 3:1 on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the day header on Today, the hero of an empty state.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page, dialog titles.

styles.name: text-strong
styles.usage: App and document names in lists, emphasis.

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Hints under controls, secondary rows, tooltips.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Panel titles, stat labels and table heads; always set uppercase.

styles.name: counter-xl
styles.usage: The headline number of a stat tile.

styles.name: data-md
styles.usage: Durations, counts and timestamps inside lists and tables.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Axis ticks, key labels, file paths, status bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside badges; gap between heatmap cells and keys.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; badge side padding; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding, list row padding, gaps between controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gutter between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; timeline lane pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side margins at desktop width.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Empty-state and onboarding breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, heat cells, timeline segments, keycaps in the heatmap.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the import sheet. Nothing rounder; pills only for the switch.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb only.

shadow.note: Borders do the separating. Shadows are for the keycap edge and for floating layers only.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: The keycap bottom edge on buttons, kbd and segmented controls; removed while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, dialogs: anything floating above the page.

size.note: Fixed control and chrome dimensions for a dense desktop app.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented controls in panel headers.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in onboarding and the import sheet.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Main navigation column.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: The status bar pinned to the bottom of the window.

tokens.name: lane-height
tokens.usage: Height of one timeline lane.
